extension.summary: Finds game manuals in the REG-Vault catalogue
extension.description:
Answers Kodi when it goes looking for a manual for a game that has none, using the REG-Vault catalogue.
There is nothing to open here. Play a game, choose Manual from the game menu, and Kodi asks this add-on what it can find.
Matching is exact: a game is found by the hash of the ROM itself, so a manual is either the right one or it is not offered. A ROM that is a different dump, region or revision to anything catalogued simply will not be found.
Manuals remain the copyright of their publishers. REG-Vault catalogues them as a preservation archive.
extension.news: 0.2.0 - Answers Kodi's find-a-manual dialog. The bulk scan is gone; Kodi asks per game now.
